scope: ACT-N11 delta: 153 product paths (23 MCP-RC, 130 PDC-X)

verification_legend.PROBE_CONFIRMED: reproduced by an auditor-owned throw-away probe (logs/probes_*.json)
verification_legend.CODE_READ_BY_AUDITOR: the auditor read the cited lines at the audited SHA; not reproduced by a run
verification_legend.TEST_RUN: observed in an auditor test run
verification_legend.SUBAGENT_READ_NOT_REPRODUCED: reported by a read-only review helper; the auditor did not re-read or reproduce it; treat as a lead for the domain audit

findings.title: Workspace scoping of a governed artifact read is optional
findings.evidence: intergrax/runtime/nexus/artifacts/governed_access.py:283 checks the stored workspace only when request.workspace_id is not None; ExecutionArtifactSource.read never requires it; authorization is the tenant-level capability artifact.read. Probe X1: artifact stored with workspace 'ws-1' is READ_OK with no workspace_id, READ_OK with 'ws-1', denied only with a wrong workspace_id (logs/probes_cross_batch.results.json).
findings.impact: any holder of artifact.read in a tenant can read any execution-evidence or tool-output artifact of that tenant (any run, any workspace) by id without naming the workspace; ids appear in context markers.
findings.disposition: ROUTE_TO_IA-D8; recommend making workspace_id (or a principal/run binding) mandatory in the request or deriving it from the context; no activation blocker (new capability, no previous behaviour regressed)

findings.title: TTL deletions can run without any audit record, and delete_artifact removes versions written after the expiry selection
findings.evidence: ArtifactRetentionSweeper(audit=None) deletes and records nothing (retention.py:_record returns when no auditor); worker_bootstrap.py:128-136 passes artifact_audit=None / artifact_governance=None through compose_worker_artifact_services (agent_runtime_context.py:501-503). Probe X3: sweep without audit deleted 'art-1' with no evidence; list_expired selected v1, a new non-expiring v2 was put, delete_artifact then left 0 versions (in-memory store; SQLite shares the semantics per the review helper).
findings.impact: destructive background deletion with optional evidence; a non-expiring new version can be destroyed by a sweep that selected the older expired version.
findings.disposition: ROUTE_TO_IA-D8; recommend refusing to build the sweeper without an audit recorder on product profiles and re-checking expiry per version inside the delete

findings.title: Recurrence occurrence identity has no tenant component; a conflict is swallowed
findings.evidence: recurrence.py:occurrence_schedule_id(rule_id, occurrence) has no tenant parameter (probe X6: params ['rule_id','occurrence'], id 'rec_daily-report_20261201T090000Z'); the id is the scheduled_resumes PRIMARY KEY (store.py:120); recurrence.py:~477 catches ScheduledResumeScheduleConflictError and returns None.
findings.impact: two tenants (or two tasks) using the same rule_id and instant collide; the second occurrence is silently not scheduled and the chain ends; a tenant can pre-claim another tenant's rule_id.
findings.disposition: ROUTE_TO_IA-D7; recommend tenant-qualified schedule ids and surfacing the conflict instead of returning None

findings.title: Several PDC-X hardening capabilities have no production caller; fail-closed behaviour exists only when a host opts in
findings.evidence: git grep at the audited SHA finds no non-test caller of resolve_critical_action_signing_wiring, resolve_security_audit_trail_wiring, assert_strict_security_configuration / validate_strict_security_configuration (only scripts/maintenance checks); bootstrap_catalogs callers do not pass require_plugin_provenance; wire_application_evaluation(env) callers do not pass tenant_id (legacy unscoped registry); SkillHostLifecycleService.upgrade_skill/disable_skill/remove_skill and SKILL_EVENT_* have no caller outside tests (also true at the pin for the signing and audit-trail wiring).
findings.impact: the ticket-level statements 'fail-closed signing / durable audit trail / plugin provenance / tenant-scoped evaluation' hold for the functions, not for a composed product host; no regression versus the pin, but no closure of the host-level behaviour either.
findings.disposition: ROUTE_TO_IA-D6 (and D1/D5); orchestrator to decide whether host composition wiring is a PDC-X claim; activation not blocked

findings.title: The baseline carries six declared-open gaps pinned as strict xfail, including a tenant-isolation gap in the memory plane
findings.evidence: logs/pdc_x_run.stdout.txt: XFAIL xd_02 FINDING-6 (DefaultMemoryControlPlane serves a foreign-tenant identity on a tenant-bound plane), p6_repair item 11 (two tests, repair held for a write-set amendment), xd_01 FINDING-9 (activated revision does not pin the model profile) and FINDING-10 (model capabilities not checked at composition), xd_12 FINDING-8 (ENT-AUDIT impact map maps none of the PDC-touched modules).
findings.impact: known, honestly declared, unrepaired gaps; FINDING-6 is a tenant-isolation weakness (same user_id across tenants) in a path the delta touches; FINDING-8 means the change-since audit selects no domain check for the PDC-touched modules.
findings.disposition: ROUTE_TO_IA-D2/D3; keep the xfails strict (they are); orchestrator to track the held write-set amendment

findings.title: A previously green EBH-5 gate is red on the baseline (hard-coded SQLite touchpoint count)
findings.evidence: tests/qualification/ebh_5/test_ebh_5_proof_integrity_gates.py::test_ebh5_proof_sqlite_closed_world_accountability fails with 'assert 39 == 38'; B-D8 added the sqlite_artifact_store touchpoint to _sqlite_touchpoint_registry.py but the literal 38 in the test was not updated. The test passes at the pin (it is not among the 13 pin failures in logs/pin_cmp.stdout.txt).
findings.impact: CI context for EBH-5 would be red after merge/activation; test-only repair.
findings.disposition: TEST_ONLY_FIX (implementer/orchestrator); not an ACT-N11 product-path change

findings.title: The new PDC-X inventory tests are red on the baseline (documents added on development are unmapped)
findings.evidence: tests/unit/governance/test_pdc_x_inventory.py: test_committed_inventory_is_current_and_closed_world and test_every_item_has_exactly_one_known_category_and_status fail ('UNMAPPED:docs/project/capabilities/architecture/ARTIFACT_LIFECYCLE.md' and two more items).
findings.impact: documentation inventory drift; no product effect.
findings.disposition: regenerate the inventory (scripts/qualification/pdc_x_inventory.py --write) by the owner

findings.title: Seven existing failures are not caused by the delta: five README contract tests and two audit-ideal depth gates are red at the pin and on the baseline
findings.evidence: pin run (13 failed): test_public_readme_contract x5, test_audit_ideal_depth_gate x6, ebh_5 proof x2; baseline: the same 5 README tests and 29_1_live_vision_profile / 30_4_production_capacity still red (the delta repaired 4 audit-ideal tests and the 2 EBH-5 parity tests). 30_4 fails with the same 'production capacity wiring requires ControlPlaneMutationAuthorizationBoundary' at both SHAs.
findings.impact: pre-existing red; counted so the orchestrator does not attribute it to PDC-X.

findings.title: pytest does not exit after its final summary when test_xd_03_agent_governance.py runs
findings.evidence: full run and per-directory bisect (logs/bisect_exit_hang*.stdout.txt): all test groups exit; tests/qualification/pdc_x/xd/test_xd_03_agent_governance.py prints '9 passed' and the process stays alive (killed after the grace period). Not root-caused (RuntimeToolInvoker owns a ThreadPoolExecutor; every test calls invoker.close()).
findings.impact: a CI job running the suite can hang to its timeout.

findings.title: GovernedArtifactReadPort._guard ignores the authorization decision value
findings.evidence: governed_access.py:_guard calls self._governance.authorize_tool(...) and discards the result; it is fail-closed only because the real boundary raises on deny/approval. Probe X2: a governance port that returns a DENY decision without raising -> READ_OK_DESPITE_DENY_DECISION.
findings.impact: any alternative AgentRuntimeGovernancePort implementation that returns instead of raising grants access.

findings.title: upgrade_skill restores the previous release only for Exception, not for BaseException
findings.evidence: host_lifecycle.py upgrade_skill: unregister(skill_id) then try/except Exception around materialize, no finally. Probe X4: a BaseException subclass raised by the materializer leaves registered_after_BaseException=False (control with RuntimeError: restored).
findings.impact: a cancelled or aborted upgrade silently uninstalls the skill; the method is unwired (F-04).

findings.title: Skill upgrade ordering ignores pre-release and build tags
findings.evidence: Probe X5: _upgrade_denial('1.2.3','1.2.4-rc.1') -> None (admitted); '1.2.3' -> '1.2.3-rc.1' and '+evil' are denied as 'not newer'.
findings.impact: a release candidate can replace a release in place.

findings.title: With a RetryPolicy, crash-interrupted RUNNING tasks are redelivered while the worker still passes idempotency_store=None
findings.evidence: colocated_worker.py:~85 recover_interrupted_running(max_retries=recovery_budget) and :~141 idempotency_store=None; document_store_task_queue.py: with max_retries set the interrupted task is settled against the budget (requeued) instead of FAILED. Default (no policy) keeps FAILED.
findings.impact: opt-in at-least-once redelivery without an idempotency ledger can double-run side effects; _on_interrupted is still called for requeued tasks.

findings.title: Recurrence materialization runs in a finally for dead tasks and a materialization failure only logs
findings.evidence: scheduler.py:~176 _materialize_next_occurrence in finally even when the checkpoint is missing or not resumable; :~217-223 except Exception logs and the chain is not retried.
findings.impact: rules without end_utc keep creating rows for a terminal task; a transient store error ends a chain silently.

findings.title: Retention sweep task trusts producer-controlled as_of and joins a helper thread without timeout
findings.evidence: retention_sweep.py:~337 as_of from the payload sets the evaluation instant; :~330 getattr(execution_identity,'tenant_id',tenant_id) falls back to the payload tenant when execution_identity is None; :~274-290 thread.join() without timeout. The forget itself still passes the control plane scope and governance checks.
findings.impact: a far-future as_of expires every entry with valid_until; cancellation/deadline cannot interrupt the blocking join.

findings.title: Lifecycle metric publishes await the exporter without a bound in the shutdown path
findings.evidence: hosting/engine/engine.py:_publish_metric awaits self._event_dispatcher.publish directly (lines ~364, 454, 636, 849, 856) and catches Exception only.
findings.impact: a hanging exporter can overrun the shutdown budget.

findings.title: A raising reindex hook turns a successful retrieval into an exception
findings.evidence: embedding_version_policy._notify_reindex_needed iterates the hooks without try/except (probe X7: hook_loop_has_try=false); retrieval_service._assess_freshness wraps only the observer call; assess_retrieval_freshness defaults request_reindex=True.
findings.impact: operator-registered hook failures break retrieval on stale sources; hooks run on the hot path.

findings.title: Freshness identity comes from mutable chunk metadata without tenant; ingest stamps an absolute server path
findings.evidence: review helper: source_freshness.chunk_source_id keys on source_path/source/source_id metadata; ingest_pipeline._source_freshness_stamp sets source_path=str(path); a file-stat observer would stat caller-controlled paths.
findings.impact: possible cross-tenant verdict collapse, path disclosure and a stat oracle if an observer uses observe_file_source.

findings.title: Provider egress filtering runs after required-source validation
findings.evidence: context_engine.py:~321-334: validate_required_sources_fulfilled(...) -> isolate_assembly_scope -> filter_fragments_by_provider_egress; excluded fragments are recorded in fragments_excluded.
findings.impact: a required source whose fragments are all above the egress ceiling passes validation and is then withheld without a RequiredContextSourceUnavailableError.

findings.title: Evidence-plane security audit trail: list_entries returns the oldest 1000 entries, secret values under benign keys are accepted, regions are bookkeeping only
findings.evidence: Probe A1: 1005 appended, 1000 listed, the newest entry is not listed. Probe A2: metadata {'note': 'sk-...'} accepted (only secret-like key names are rejected). multi_region_audit_trail.py appends the same entry id to in-memory per-region lists in lockstep; verify_replication compares those lists.
findings.impact: newest audit entries invisible to list_entries beyond 1000 per tenant; 'multi-region replication' evidence is not independent replication.

findings.title: Plugin provenance: attestation lookup is bound to the operator mapping key, not to attestation.distribution; installed file digest is never checked
findings.evidence: Probe PV1: attestations={'victim-plugin': <valid attestation of 'other-signed-plugin'>} admits the 'victim-plugin' entry point (rejection=null). Probe PV2: PluginProvenanceAdmission.evaluate consults only the installed version (docstring: does not re-hash).
findings.impact: a mis-keyed mapping vouches for another distribution; a tampered install with the attested version string passes.

findings.title: HostDeploymentProfile changed from extra='forbid' to extra='allow'; unknown keys and a wide bind host are accepted
findings.evidence: Probe C1: business_agents_deploy_enabld (typo) accepted into model_extra while the typed flag stays False; lkw_daemon_bind_host='0.0.0.0' accepted by LkwHybridDaemonDeployment; port 70000 and nested values are rejected.
findings.impact: misspelled deployment keys are silently ignored; non-loopback bind is not constrained (default stays 127.0.0.1).

findings.title: Non-strict profiles sign boundary events with the public demo seed when no key is set
findings.evidence: attestation_runtime_bridge.py:54 lab_demo_seed_opt_in=not strict; probe X8: lab_defaults builds a sealer with an empty environment, product_defaults is refused (demo_seed_forbidden_in_strict_profile). The seed constant remains in host_attestation.py.
findings.impact: host-signed evidence of any non-PRODUCT, non-STRICT profile is forgeable by anyone who reads the source; by design for lab, but the opt-in is implicit.

findings.title: Evaluation evidence digests are verified against digests stored with the payload; promotion comparisons are caller-supplied
findings.evidence: review helper: eval_evidence_contracts.read_eval_*_evidence compare payload to a digest in the same metadata; agent_promotion.evaluate_agent_promotion accepts evaluation_comparisons without tenant or digest check; evaluation can only block, never authorize.
findings.impact: a block can be bypassed by omission or forgery; authorization is unaffected.

findings.title: Online evaluation registry: cross-tenant observation id existence oracle and lock-file removal after the stale timeout
findings.evidence: review helper: get_observation returns the first match across tenants (denied vs KeyError); _exclusive unlinks the lock in finally so a holder longer than stale_lock_seconds loses it; unscoped list_observations still returns all tenants.
findings.impact: id existence leak; lost updates under long holders.

findings.title: Agent upgrade admission: 0.x compatibility rule, pre-release ordering, replay paths before authorization, candidate left VERIFIED on an unguarded exception
findings.evidence: review helper: semver_compat accepts 0.1.0->0.9.0; upgrade_admission._semver_key drops pre-release; admin_service.upgrade_agent/retire_agent return replay views before _authorize_desired_state_mutation; an exception between create_candidate_installation and the guarded blocks leaves the candidate VERIFIED.
findings.impact: weaker upgrade gate than documented; authorization skipped on replay (mirrors install_agent replay).

findings.title: Run artifact bundle builder follows file symlinks under the sandbox root and now publishes a content digest
findings.evidence: review helper: run_artifact_bundle_builder rglob('*') + is_file() + read_bytes()/resolve().as_uri(); sha256 computed from the read bytes; staged application artifacts may name another tenant_id.
findings.impact: hash oracle for a file outside the sandbox; the read itself pre-dates the pin.

findings.title: Retention and artifact store edge cases: naive/aware datetime TypeError kills the sweep, one tampered row fails every tenant listing, unaudited store errors after authorization, legal-hold overwrite without ownership, negative sweep limit
findings.evidence: review helper: InMemoryArtifactStore.list_expired compares datetimes without normalization; SQLite _to_artifact raises ArtifactDigestMismatchError for list calls; _guard audits only a fixed exception list; place_legal_hold uses INSERT OR REPLACE; make_retention_sweep_handler does not range-check limit.
findings.impact: availability and evidence-completeness edge cases.

findings.title: Mutation sample: two redundant tenant checks are not pinned by any PDC-X test
findings.evidence: 12 mutants on D1/D5/D6/D8 paths: 10 killed; P6 (EvidencePlaneSecurityAuditTrail.list_entries event.tenant_id re-check) and P9 (GovernedArtifactReadPort stored-tenant re-check) survive the wide PDC-X suites (logs/mutation_sample_pass2_wide.stdout.txt). Both checks are redundant with tenant-keyed stores today, so the mutants are likely equivalent; no test uses a hostile source or port.
findings.impact: the defence-in-depth checks could be removed without a test failing.

findings.title: raw_secret_gate is a heuristic AST scan with known evasions
findings.evidence: Probe G1: detected: direct os.environ.get/getenv fallback, default= keyword, plain/attribute/dataclass named literals, a full sk- token literal. Not detected: string concatenation, f-string, bytes literal, dict-literal key, split sk- token, 'os.environ.get(...) or "literal"'.
findings.impact: the gate is not a proof of absence of literals; the module docstring says so.

findings.title: Behaviour changes that can break callers: sha256 fields now accept only empty or 64 lowercase hex; storage_presigned_url always raises
findings.evidence: Probe C2: uppercase and 'sha256:'-prefixed values rejected, empty accepted, RunArtifactBundle.durable_refs raises ArtifactDigestRequiredError for an empty digest (C3). Review helper: storage_presigned_url raises GovernedPresignRequiredError and never calls the provider.
findings.impact: stricter, fail-closed; callers expecting the old behaviour break loudly.

findings.title: Existing tests were retargeted rather than removed; two claims in the gate script are not met
findings.evidence: ebh_5 tests replace the literal '== 56' by a derived set; gr10 AST gates were retargeted to development commits 6700ff756 and 716ed746f; test_public_readme_contract allows the scenario-factory asset root. No skip, no importorskip, no new xfail outside the declared PDC gaps was added. scripts/gates/check_mvp_promotion_gates.py: the docstring says G0 and G2 check that modules define the required symbols, but their required-symbol tuples are empty (only G1 defines one).
findings.impact: no weakened product-path test found; G0/G2 remain existence checks.
findings.disposition: ACCEPT; correct the docstring or add symbols

findings.title: The import-boundary gate is red on both the pin and the baseline for 12 files the delta did not touch
findings.evidence: scripts/maintenance/check_intergrax_no_applications_imports.py lists 12 intergrax/runtime/** files importing applications packages (output identical at the pin and at the audited SHA; none is in the 153 changed paths). Auditor scan of the added lines of all 130 PDC-X diffs, and all three review helpers, found no new import of agents or applications from intergrax/ and none of applications from agents/. scripts/maintenance/check_architecture_boundary_chaos.py fails on a wrong script path (scripts/check_intergrax_no_applications_imports.py) and spawns uv run.
findings.impact: the delta adds no boundary violation; the pre-existing ones are outside this audit.

findings.title: The shared .venv lacks tzdata that the baseline pyproject now declares
findings.evidence: pyproject.toml adds tzdata for win32 and uv.lock changed; pytest collection of tests/qualification/pdc_x/d7/test_d7_recurrence.py fails with ZoneInfoNotFoundError in the unsynced venv (logs/pdc_x_batches_first_attempt_missing_tzdata.log); uv lock --check passes.
findings.impact: operators must sync the environment before running the suite on Windows.
findings.disposition: ACCEPT; note in the activation record
